core_obligations: Reformulate through the perfection (proof lines 23720-23730): by the flatness-chapter lemma O^h = O^perf = colim_F O, and by the previous lemma O^perf viewed in D((Sch/S)_fppf) is R epsilon_*K for some K in D((Sch/S)_h); since O^perf is an h-sheaf one has K = epsilon^{-1}O^perf = O^perf, hence R epsilon_*O^perf = O^perf.
Apply Leray (proof lines 23731-23738): the Leray spectral sequence for the comparison gives R Gamma_h(S, O^perf) = R Gamma_fppf(S, R epsilon_*O^perf) = R Gamma_fppf(S, O^perf).
Compute the fppf cohomology (proof lines 23739-23746): since S is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, H^i_fppf(S, O^perf) = colim_F H^i_fppf(S, O), which is the displayed formula.
proof_roadmap: Identify the h-sheafification of the structure sheaf with the perfection and use the previous lemma to see that the perfection is its own h-pushforward.
Apply Leray to rewrite the h-cohomology as fppf cohomology of the perfection.
Compute that fppf cohomology as the colimit over the Frobenius twists.
difficulty_reason: The proposition computes the h-cohomology of the perfected structure sheaf of a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme over F_p as the colimit of the cohomologies of the structure sheaf (statement lines 23707-23717). The proof (proof lines 23719-23746) identifies the sheaf with the perfection, uses the essential-image statement to see that it equals its own h-pushforward, applies Leray to pass to fppf cohomology, and computes the colimit there. H2: one identification plus one Leray computation.
